# white_moka_pot — realism QA

Evidence: f1367, f1208, f1223. Fixed calibrated cameras and common instance pose. Mean visible IoU 0.803; worst 0.797; RGB histogram intersection 0.697. Review: `../review/white_moka_pot_compare.jpg`.

Grades: silhouette B, proportions B, colour_texture B, articulation B, physics B, collision B, instances B.

- Widened waist and upper collector to match ivory pot proportions.
- Replaced angular projecting handle with thicker rounded ivory grip.
- Moved pressure valve onto opposite body face, consistent with the visible face lacking a gold button.
- Replaced coarse three/four-wall contact proxies with matching octagonal shells, thin lid plate and separate knob.
- Preserved real rear hinge DOF and removable boiler/collector bodies.
- Enlarged lid knob and fit lower/waist/upper radii independently.
- Refined the common pose, yaw and dimensions against 400-pixel masks; rebuilt and confirmed the silhouette score in calibrated Cycles renders.
- Refined documented per-view exposure in Cycles to match capture auto-exposure; no raster recoloring or reflection baking.
- Round 2: refined ivory enamel reflectance, roughness and clearcoat response while retaining the separate boiler, collector and hinged lid.
- Round 2: refined a single common pose and size against all three fixed-camera silhouettes, with extra weight on the weakest view.
- Added three calibrated evidence views, source-only manual masks, numeric IoU and masked RGB histogram comparisons.
- Added physics mass/density/friction/restitution/COM/fragility metadata with uncertainty and synchronized native rigid bodies.

Remaining:
- Thread pitch, filter internals, hinge stop angle and screw release are inferred/unobserved.
- Shelf and cabinet occlusion hide part of the body in some views.
- Product identity and actual weighed mass are unverified; physics parameters are explicitly estimated.
- External scene integration: the separate cabinetry support differs from this photo-fitted base by -23.8 mm. Its assumed shelf elevation needs reconciliation; cookware was not moved off its source fit. See review/support_reconciliation.json.

Mass is an engineering prior, not the real product weight. `physics` includes the shell-area check, density, 40% mass uncertainty, per-body COM and contact coefficients. No deformable item is present in this set.

Per-view bounding dimensions and three projected width samples are measured in source pixels. Rim wall thickness, hidden hinge internals and unreadable markings cannot be resolved to physical accuracy from these images; nominal values are not photo measurements.

Previous notes are archived in `../review/before/white_moka_pot/notes.md`; current geometry, poses and physical properties are authoritative in `model.json`. GLB contains visuals; load the JSON joints/collision mapping for simulation.
